title: flank129: read the 129-strain DNA around a targeted gene from a knockout study's own RNA-seq reads
description: flank129 genotypes every sample of a knockout RNA-seq study at the single-nucleotide sites where 129S1/SvImJ, 129P2/OlaHsd and 129S5/SvEvBrd share a non-reference allele, calls 1 Mb bins as 129-carrying, and reports the segments in which every knockout and no control carries 129 alleles, with the differentially expressed genes inside them.
